text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond isn't feeling well, so I have her rest in the infirmary…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for worrying you. I should feel better after a little rest…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: If you'll excuse me, I'm going to take a nap.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where am I?

text_block_list.name: Satono Group Executive
text_block_list.text: We're pleased to have you here for the announcement of our latest product.

text_block_list.name: Satono Group Executive
text_block_list.text: Today, I am proud to announce the latest innovation from the Satono Group! Introducing the Virtumusume… Umagine!

text_block_list.name: Umagine
text_block_list.text: Whirrr, clink, clank!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Incredible! It's as if 3D polygons have leapt out of a computer screen and into the real world!

text_block_list.name: Satono Group Executive
text_block_list.text: Now, try controlling her with our custom double lever controller!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oooh, is it really okay? …Here goes! ♪

text_block_list.name: Umagine
text_block_list.text: Zooooom!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ahh! She's moving! And she handles like a dream! Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Satono Group Executive
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Now, please leave all future races to Umagine! We'd like you to pilot her!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No way! I simply cannot agree to that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I will run my own races! I will live up to everyone's expectations and the Satono family's wishes… And I'll do it with my own two legs!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hyah?! Was that… just a dream?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Even if it was, these feelings of mine are real. I won't stop racing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond wakes up from her dream feeling more energetic than ever!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Would it be better for a robot to run in my place at my current level?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I wonder if she can live up to everyone's expectations better than I can…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Was that… just a dream?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But even if it was… Why am I having such negative thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to her nightmare, Satono Diamond doesn't manage to get enough rest.
